additive_build_content:
cc_library(name = "torch_headers", hdrs = glob(["site-packages/torch/**/*.h", "site-packages/torch/**/*.hpp", "site-packages/torch/**/*.hh", "site-packages/torch/**/*.hxx", "site-packages/torch/**/*.cuh", "site-packages/torch/**/*.inc", "site-packages/torch/**/*.inl", "site-packages/torch/**/*.tcc"]), includes = ["site-packages/torch/include", "site-packages/torch/include/torch/c10", "site-packages/torch/include/torch/csrc/api/include", "."], visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

cc_library(name = "libc10", srcs = glob(["site-packages/torch/lib/libc10.so", "site-packages/torch/lib/libc10.dylib"]), visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

cc_library(name = "libtorch_cpu", srcs = glob(["site-packages/torch/lib/libtorch_cpu.so", "site-packages/torch/lib/libtorch_cpu.dylib"]), visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

cc_library(name = "libshm", srcs = glob(["site-packages/torch/lib/libshm.so", "site-packages/torch/lib/libshm.dylib"]), visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

cc_library(name = "libtorch_python", srcs = glob(["site-packages/torch/lib/libtorch_python.so", "site-packages/torch/lib/libtorch_python.dylib"]), visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

# TODO: figure out why torch_tpu is linking libpython at all and stop it
cc_library(name = "libpython", # ALLOW_CC_TARGETS=External rules_python hub repo cannot use main macros
srcs = glob(["site-packages/torch/lib/libpython3.*.so*"]), visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

cc_library(name = "libtorch", srcs = glob(["site-packages/torch/lib/libtorch.so", "site-packages/torch/lib/libtorch.dylib"]), deps = [":libc10", ":libtorch_cpu", ":libshm"], visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

cc_library(name = "libtorch_global_deps", deps = [":libc10", ":libtorch_cpu"], visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

cc_library(name = "torch_libs", deps = [":libtorch", ":libtorch_python", ":libtorch_global_deps", ":libpython"], visibility = ["//visibility:public"])
